definition: Techniques and system designs aimed at preventing or mitigating prompt injection attacks, such as input sanitization, privilege separation, or explicit instruction hierarchies.
details: Prompt injection defense remains an active and unsolved area of research, since the flexible, general-purpose nature of language models makes it inherently difficult to perfectly distinguish trusted instructions from adversarial content embedded in processed data.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. In plain words: Techniques and system designs aimed at preventing or mitigating prompt injection attacks, such as input sanitization, privilege separation, or explicit instruction hierarchies. Here is how it actually plays out: Prompt injection defense remains an active and unsolved area of research, since the flexible, general-purpose nature of language models makes it inherently difficult to perfectly distinguish trusted instructions from adversarial content embedded in processed data. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Prompt Injection Defense.
